total_process_count.our_definition: Count of active processes present in pslist at point of volatile snapshot.
total_process_count.public_definition: Cumulative count of unique processes executed over the 60-120s sandbox window.
total_process_count.assumptions: Measures total process footprint over execution timeline rather than instantaneous snapshot.
total_process_count.limitations: Cumulative count is an upper bound on concurrent instantaneous active processes.

hidden_process_count.our_definition: Processes found in psscan but unlinked from pslist active process doubly-linked list.
hidden_process_count.public_definition: Not measured in dynamic sandbox userland/kernel trace without raw memory scan.
hidden_process_count.assumptions: Cannot infer kernel active process list unlinking from dynamic execution alone.

anomalous_ppid_count.our_definition: Count of processes violating core Windows parent-child lineage rules.
anomalous_ppid_count.public_definition: Count of parent PID hierarchy discrepancies identified from behavior.processtree.
anomalous_ppid_count.assumptions: Process tree parent-child links accurately record PID lineage.
anomalous_ppid_count.limitations: PPID spoofing via explicit startup info attributes may conceal true creator.

avg_threads_per_process.our_definition: Mean thread count across all enumerated active processes.
avg_threads_per_process.public_definition: Not enumerated in standard sandbox summary JSON.
avg_threads_per_process.assumptions: Kernel thread counts per process not dumped in summary.

max_threads_in_single_process.our_definition: Maximum thread count observed in any single individual process.
max_threads_in_single_process.public_definition: Not enumerated in standard sandbox summary JSON.
max_threads_in_single_process.assumptions: Kernel thread counts per process not dumped in summary.

total_handle_count.our_definition: Total count of active Windows kernel object handles open across all processes.
total_handle_count.public_definition: Cumulative open handle count across monitored processes during execution.
total_handle_count.assumptions: Tracks handle volume across workload processes.
total_handle_count.limitations: Measures monitored processes only, not system-wide total handles.

suspicious_dll_count.our_definition: Count of loaded DLLs located in user-writable or temporary staging directories.
suspicious_dll_count.public_definition: Count of loaded module paths matching AppData/Temp/Public staging paths in behavior.processes[].loaded_modules.
suspicious_dll_count.transformation: sum(1 for m in loaded_modules if is_staging_path(m))
suspicious_dll_count.assumptions: DLL load notifications captured by sandbox kernel monitor.
suspicious_dll_count.limitations: Manual mapping / reflective DLL loads without LoadLibrary will be missed.

malfind_process_count.our_definition: Count of unique processes containing suspicious executable memory flagged by malfind.
malfind_process_count.public_definition: Volatility malfind plugin not run on dynamic sandbox RAM.

elevated_privilege_count.our_definition: Count of processes holding high-risk administrative tokens (SeDebugPrivilege, etc.).
elevated_privilege_count.public_definition: Token privilege adjustments not dumped in standard summary.
elevated_privilege_count.assumptions: Process token privilege bitmaps require memory forensics.

unlinked_dll_count.our_definition: Count of modules in ldrmodules where InLoadOrder or InMemoryOrder is False.
unlinked_dll_count.public_definition: PEB doubly-linked list vs memory VAD discrepancy not measured in sandbox.

raw_command_text.our_definition: Authentic command line string or PowerShell script block executed during the workload.
raw_command_text.public_definition: Authentic command line captured by Sysmon Event ID 1 / CAPEv2 process monitoring.
raw_command_text.assumptions: Exact text of executed command captured at process creation.
raw_command_text.limitations: Traces that execute zero commands cannot produce command telemetry.

command_length.our_definition: Character length of primary sanitized command string.
command_length.public_definition: Character length of raw command string.

shannon_entropy.our_definition: Shannon entropy of characters within command line string (bits/char).
shannon_entropy.public_definition: Shannon character entropy computed over raw command string.

is_base64_encoded.our_definition: Binary indicator (0 or 1) indicating PowerShell base64 execution flags (-enc, -encodedcommand).
is_base64_encoded.public_definition: Regex match for BASE64_COMMAND_FLAGS on command line.
is_base64_encoded.transformation: 1 if any(p.search(cmd) for p in BASE64_COMMAND_FLAGS) else 0

has_download_cradle.our_definition: Binary indicator (0 or 1) detecting web download cradles (DownloadString, IEX, WebClient).
has_download_cradle.public_definition: Regex match for DOWNLOAD_CRADLE_PATTERNS on command line.
has_download_cradle.transformation: 1 if any(p.search(cmd) for p in DOWNLOAD_CRADLE_PATTERNS) else 0

has_bypass_execution_policy.our_definition: Binary indicator (0 or 1) detecting PowerShell execution policy bypass (-ep bypass).
has_bypass_execution_policy.public_definition: Regex match for BYPASS_POLICY_PATTERNS on command line.
has_bypass_execution_policy.transformation: 1 if any(p.search(cmd) for p in BYPASS_POLICY_PATTERNS) else 0

has_hidden_window.our_definition: Binary indicator (0 or 1) detecting stealth window flags (-w hidden, -windowstyle hidden).
has_hidden_window.public_definition: Regex match for HIDDEN_WINDOW_PATTERNS on command line.
has_hidden_window.transformation: 1 if any(p.search(cmd) for p in HIDDEN_WINDOW_PATTERNS) else 0

uses_lolbins.our_definition: Binary indicator (0 or 1) detecting execution of living-off-the-land binaries.
uses_lolbins.public_definition: Case-insensitive check of process binary or cmdline against LOLBINS_HIGH_RISK dictionary.
uses_lolbins.source_field: any(lb in cmd_lower for lb in LOLBINS_HIGH_RISK)
uses_lolbins.transformation: 1 if any(lb in cmd.lower() for lb in LOLBINS_HIGH_RISK) else 0
uses_lolbins.limitations: Renamed binaries without path verification may bypass simple string matching.

registry_persistence_count.our_definition: Count of registry modifications targeting persistence keys (Run, RunOnce, Winlogon).
registry_persistence_count.public_definition: Count of persistence registry paths touched in behavior.summary.registry or command regex.
registry_persistence_count.transformation: sum(1 for p in REGISTRY_PERSISTENCE_PATTERNS if p.search(cmd))
registry_persistence_count.assumptions: Persistence keys created via command line or sandbox registry monitor.
registry_persistence_count.limitations: Direct kernel registry writes not visible on command line.

active_connection_count.our_definition: Count of active TCP sockets in ESTABLISHED/SYN_SENT state at snapshot timestamp.
active_connection_count.public_definition: Cumulative TCP connection count recorded over sandbox execution period.
active_connection_count.assumptions: Approximates connection activity; measures cumulative rather than instantaneous connections.
active_connection_count.limitations: Cumulative connections exceed instantaneous socket table snapshot.

listening_port_count.our_definition: Count of unique local TCP/UDP ports open in LISTEN state.
listening_port_count.public_definition: Not reliably captured in sandbox summaries (sandboxes monitor outbound flows).
listening_port_count.assumptions: Local listening port tables require host netstat/Get-NetTCPConnection snapshots.
listening_port_count.limitations: 100% missing in standard CAPEv2 network summaries.

outbound_connection_count.our_definition: Count of network connections directed to remote IP addresses outside local subnet.
outbound_connection_count.public_definition: Count of external outbound TCP/UDP connections recorded by sandbox monitor.
outbound_connection_count.source_field: len([c for c in network.tcp if not is_local(c['dst'])])
outbound_connection_count.transformation: len([c for c in network.get('tcp', []) if not is_local(c.get('dst', ''))])
outbound_connection_count.assumptions: Outbound destination IP addresses are non-RFC1918.

dns_query_count.our_definition: Count of DNS query resolution events.
dns_query_count.public_definition: Count of DNS queries resolved during analysis in network.dns.
dns_query_count.assumptions: DNS requests intercepted by sandbox internal DNS sniffer.

unique_remote_ips.our_definition: Count of distinct external remote IP addresses contacted.
unique_remote_ips.public_definition: Cardinality of distinct external IP addresses in network.hosts.

avg_interpacket_interval_ms.our_definition: Mean time interval in milliseconds between consecutive network packets.
avg_interpacket_interval_ms.public_definition: Raw packet timestamps omitted from JSON report.
avg_interpacket_interval_ms.limitations: 100% missing in JSON reports. Faithfully matches custom-domain host-only missingness.

beacon_regularity_score.our_definition: Normalized score measuring periodic regularity of C2 beacon packets.
beacon_regularity_score.public_definition: Raw packet timestamps omitted from JSON report.
beacon_regularity_score.limitations: 100% missing in JSON reports. Faithfully matches custom-domain host-only missingness.

total_bytes_sent.our_definition: Total bytes transmitted outbound across network connections.
total_bytes_sent.public_definition: Cumulative bytes sent recorded in network summary.
total_bytes_sent.limitations: Cumulative volume over 120s vs instantaneous point-in-time bytes.

total_bytes_received.our_definition: Total bytes received inbound across network connections.
total_bytes_received.public_definition: Cumulative bytes received recorded in network summary.
total_bytes_received.limitations: Cumulative volume over 120s vs instantaneous point-in-time bytes.

suspicious_port_usage.our_definition: Binary indicator (0 or 1) indicating connection activity on known suspicious ports (8080, 8443, 9001, 4444).
suspicious_port_usage.public_definition: Destination port membership check on network.tcp and network.udp.
suspicious_port_usage.transformation: 1 if any(c.get('dport') in SUSPICIOUS_PORTS for c in network.get('tcp', [])) else 0

rwx_page_count.our_definition: Count of committed memory VAD allocations with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE.
rwx_page_count.public_definition: Not measured in dynamic sandbox execution reports.
rwx_page_count.assumptions: Requires full volatile RAM dump and VAD tree traversal.

injected_code_regions.our_definition: Total count of suspicious injected code regions flagged by malfind.
injected_code_regions.public_definition: Not measured in dynamic sandbox execution reports.

unmapped_executable_pages.our_definition: Executable memory regions that have no backing file on disk.
unmapped_executable_pages.public_definition: Not measured in dynamic sandbox execution reports.
unmapped_executable_pages.assumptions: Requires Volatility3 vadinfo unmapped page traversal.

vad_protection_anomaly_count.our_definition: Count of VAD allocations where InitProtection != Protection.
vad_protection_anomaly_count.public_definition: Not measured in dynamic sandbox execution reports.

ldrmodules_inconsistencies.our_definition: Sum of discrepancies across PEB module lists (InLoadOrder, InMemoryOrder, InInitOrder).
ldrmodules_inconsistencies.public_definition: Not measured in dynamic sandbox execution reports.

yara_shellcode_matches.our_definition: Count of YARA rule hits on memory VAD allocations.
yara_shellcode_matches.public_definition: Memory YARA scans not executed across volatile RAM.

mean_memory_entropy.our_definition: Average Shannon entropy computed over dumped raw bytes of injected memory regions.

max_memory_entropy.our_definition: Maximum Shannon entropy observed across any single injected memory region.
